items.title: Talking about daily routines
items.summary: Use the simple present to describe habits and regular activities.
learning_objectives: Recognise simple-present statements about regular activities.
Build a basic subject + verb + object sentence.
Use the third-person singular -s form in a simple sentence.

body.explanation_en: Use the simple present for habits, routines and facts. With I, you, we and they, use the base verb. With he, she and it, the verb usually takes -s or -es.
body.explanation_ml: പതിവായി ചെയ്യുന്ന കാര്യങ്ങൾ, ദിനചര്യകൾ, പൊതുവായ സത്യങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ പറയാൻ Simple Present ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. I, you, we, they എന്നിവയ്ക്കൊപ്പം സാധാരണ verb-ന്റെ base form ഉപയോഗിക്കും. He, she, it എന്നിവയ്ക്കൊപ്പം പലപ്പോഴും verb-ന് -s അല്ലെങ്കിൽ -es ചേർക്കും.

common_errors.reason_en: Use works with she in a simple-present affirmative sentence.

guided_practice.hint_en: Use the base verb with I.

body.independent_prompt: Write one sentence about something you do every day.
completion_criteria: Uses a suitable simple-present verb form.

common_errors: Omitting -s/-es with he, she or it.
Adding -s to the verb after I, you, we or they.

items.title: Talking about yesterday
items.summary: Use the simple past to describe completed actions in the past.
learning_objectives: Use common regular and irregular past-tense verbs.
Describe one event that happened yesterday.

body.explanation_en: Use the simple past for an action or event completed at a past time. Regular verbs often take -ed; many common verbs are irregular and must be learned in context.
body.explanation_ml: കഴിഞ്ഞുപോയ ഒരു സമയത്ത് പൂർത്തിയായ പ്രവർത്തനമോ സംഭവമോ പറയാൻ Simple Past ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. ചില verbs-ന് -ed ചേർക്കും; go → went പോലുള്ള irregular verbs പ്രത്യേകം പഠിക്കണം.

examples.en: I went to the office yesterday.
We watched a movie last night.
examples.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ഇന്നലെ രാത്രി ഒരു സിനിമ കണ്ടു.

common_errors.incorrect: Yesterday I go to the office.
common_errors.correct: Yesterday I went to the office.
common_errors.reason_en: The event is completed in the past; use went, the past form of go.

guided_practice.explanation_en: The past form of eat is ate.

body.independent_prompt: Write two sentences about what you did yesterday.
completion_criteria: Uses a correct past-tense verb in a meaningful sentence.

common_errors: Using the base form after a clear past-time reference.
Adding -ed to irregular verbs such as go, eat and see.

items.title: Introducing yourself
items.summary: Practise a short, natural self-introduction in everyday situations.
learning_objectives: Say your name and where you are from.
Ask the other person a simple introductory question.

body.explanation_en: A simple introduction can include a greeting, your name and one relevant detail. You do not need to memorise a long speech.
body.explanation_ml: സ്വയം പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുമ്പോൾ ഒരു അഭിവാദ്യം, പേര്, ആവശ്യമായ ഒരു ചെറിയ വിവരം എന്നിവ പറഞ്ഞാൽ മതി. നീണ്ട പ്രസംഗം മനഃപാഠമാക്കേണ്ടതില്ല.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! I'm Anu. What's your name?
dialogue.ml: ഹലോ! എന്റെ പേര് അനു. നിങ്ങളുടെ പേര് എന്താണ്?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hi, I'm Rahul. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?

useful_phrases.function: Ask about someone's work or usual occupation; use politely and in a suitable context.

body.independent_prompt: Introduce yourself in two or three sentences. Share only details you are comfortable sharing.
completion_criteria: Can ask or respond to one introductory question.

common_errors: Using an unnecessarily long memorised introduction.
Confusing where someone is from with where they currently live.
